# Item

> Per-player item counts in the profile: Give / Remove / Has / Count.

- Package: `Item` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Item")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Item`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/ItemService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Item = GaxiaServer.Item
```

### Functions

- `Item.Give(player: Player, itemId: string, count: number?): (boolean, number?)`
  Returns (ok, deliveredDelta). The delta can be less than the requested count (per-item clamp absorbing into a near-full stack) — callers that echo the amount back to a human must report the delta, not the request.
- `Item.Remove(player: Player, itemId: string, count: number?): boolean`
- `Item.Has(player: Player, itemId: string, count: number?): boolean`
- `Item.Count(player: Player, itemId: string): number`
- `Item.GetInventory(player: Player): { [string]: number }?`
- `Item.Clear(player: Player, itemId: string): ()`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Item.OnItemChanged` — `Signal<Player, string, number, number>`
  (player, itemId, newCount, delta) after every Give / Remove / Clear that changed a count
